title: A clock for a wave
hook: Change frequency and predict wave period.
misconception: wave period doubles when frequency doubles, regardless of the stated relationship.
objective: Apply T = 1/f to compare wave period when frequency changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a periodic wave, T = 1/f. When frequency doubles, wave period becomes ½ times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model T = 1/f; scaling exponent -1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a periodic wave, with a nonzero initial result. If frequency triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on wave period?
recall.why: Apply T = 1/f under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 1/3.
